title: Reservations, savings plans and Azure Hybrid Benefit

videos.script: Pay as you go is the most expensive way to run something that runs all the time. {{payg}} Azure offers a discount for a promise: one year or three, of a certain size, or a certain spend. {{promise}} The discount is real, and so is the risk. Promise too much and you pay for hours nobody uses. {{risk}} This lesson measures a month of the shop's workers, and finds the size of promise that is cheapest. The answer is smaller than most people guess. {{end}}
